title: Change name or contact details on a security operative licence
summary: You can change your contact details (address, email, mobile, or telephone number) on a security operative licence online.
intro: You can change your contact details (address, email, mobile or telephone number) on a security operative licence online.
what_you_need: Your previous and current contact details
The PDF form: Application to Amend, Vary or Replace an Existing Class 1 and/or Class 2 licence
A certified copy of a change of name document from a Justice of the Peace, Legal Practitioner, or Notary Public (if changing name/personal details)

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to change your contact details.
Download and complete the form Application to Amend, Vary or Replace an Existing Class 1 and/or Class 2 licence – PDF'.
Send the form and your documents (if applicable) by post to the address on the form.

faqs.q: How do I change my contact details on my security operative licence?
faqs.a: To change your contact details, you must check your security operative licence number and details via Verify NSW.

faqs.q: What do I need if I want to change my name or other personal details?
faqs.a: If you need to change your name or other personal details, you must provide change of name documents certified by a Justice of the Peace, Legal Practitioner, or Notary Public.

faqs.q: What is the process for changing my licence details?
faqs.a: You can start by selecting the 'Change online' button, logging in or creating a MyServiceNSW Account, and following the prompts to change your contact details. You may also need to download and complete the form 'Application to Amend, Vary or Replace an Existing Class 1 and/or Class 2 licence' and send it by post.
